title: Delivery confidence: the department's major projects
description: Four projects, each with a delivery confidence rating and the reason for it, drawn in the accent theme so the marks are coloured as well as shaped and named.
caption: Green: delivery highly likely. Amber: feasible, with significant issues to manage. Red: unachievable without major change.

rows.note: Supplier testing is three months behind; the go-live window is still held.
Two of three sites closed, on budget.
Scope doubled after the policy change; a reset is going to the board in March.
Live since June; benefits are being tracked.
